reason: dev skill_pooled +0.0129 vs champion exp_000 (need >= +0.002); holdout -0.0756 (need >= -0.0)
lesson: Rejected, and a clear overfit: per-gpu_model calibration won DEV by +0.013 (geomean +0.115 -> +0.184) by narrowing bands (coverage 0.80 -> 0.75, above_q90 0.12 -> 0.17), then lost -0.076 on HOLDOUT. Sharing interval offsets across collectors mixes instruments with different change regimes (rate cards step, marketplace asks drift); collector x class is the right calibration unit. A DEV win that comes with a coverage drop is a warning sign. The per-series self-rescaling alternative (vol_tail) was worse on DEV and was not submitted.
